claims: Circle says USDC is natively available on XRPL mainnet with no bridging required.
Circle Mint and Circle APIs support USDC on XRPL; qualified businesses can apply for fiat on/off ramps.
Issuer address and currency code are published.
limitations: Launch announcement proves availability, not current adoption or transaction volume.

claims: Circle USDC supply 6.02M, 10,806 holders, 17,631 trustlines; last activity 16:00 UTC.
24h volume 107,537.19 USDC, 1,756 trades and 175 payments.
Largest USDC/XRP pool: 130.29k USDC and 104.3k XRP; 161 LP holders; 33,522 trades in 30 days.
USDC/RLUSD pool: 26.17k USDC and 25.08k RLUSD; 24 LP holders; 144 trades in 30 days.
limitations: WinDB follows the ledger by a few minutes; history is reconstructed from daily balances and retained for two years.

claims: RLUSD supply approximately $711.83M on XRPL and $1.71B on Ethereum, $2.42B total.
XRPL share 29.4%; Ethereum share 70.6%.
24h XRPL net supply change +$4.47M; dashboard says this agrees with independent RPC for 2026-10-31 finalized data.
limitations: Page reported live feed unavailable while snapshot totals were refreshed minutes earlier; supply values may be a few minutes stale.

claims: XRP-paired AMM TVL about $35.93M; 30,271 pools ranked; 7,953 token-token pairs excluded from headline dollar TVL.
XRP/RLUSD pool listed around $5.38M; top ten pools represented 52.8% of XRP-paired TVL.
Order-book DEX is not included in the AMM headline.
limitations: AMM-only measure; order-book liquidity excluded; many pools have negligible TVL.

claims: Pool wallet snapshot reports 1,869,218 XRP and 2,337,494 RLUSD, 199 trustlines and 200 transactions over 30 days across one active day.
Dashboard reports 198 recent swaps and net +1,441 XRP over its most recent 200-swap window.
limitations: Wallet page ledger index 108047846 differs from dashboard's newer live ledger; retain as a separate older pool snapshot, not synchronized with the pool ranking.

claims: LendingProtocol, SingleAssetVault and LendingProtocolV1_1 remain in validator voting; native lending is not live.
Both LendingProtocol and SingleAssetVault must activate before the loan-broker board populates.
limitations: Dashboard interpretation; signed snapshot separately records 19/35 and 21/35 votes at 01:00 UTC.

claims: Snapshot envelope provides Ed25519 signature, Merkle audit path, chain root and a public-key fingerprint.
Snapshot records 707.358M RLUSD supply, 30,279 AMM pools and $35.965M AMM TVL; metrics have their own as-of timestamps.
At 01:00 UTC LendingProtocol had 19/35 votes and SingleAssetVault 21/35 against a 28/35 threshold.
limitations: Signature and Merkle path were not independently verified in this run; some metrics are older than the snapshot date.

claims: Mastercard named Circle USDC and Ripple RLUSD among regulated stablecoins for expanded onchain settlement capabilities and named XRPL among supported networks.
Initial named partners include ARQ, CBW Bank, Cross River, Lead Bank and Nuvei.
limitations: No public stablecoin-by-chain matrix or XRPL-specific settlement volumes; named initial partners are not identified as XRPL deployments.

claims: OKX says RLUSD can be traded across 280+ spot pairs and accepted as institutional-grade margin collateral in select markets.
XRP/RLUSD is a named pair; RLUSD is natively issued on XRPL and Ethereum.
limitations: Margin-collateral eligibility is region/product dependent; this does not establish XRP itself as collateral.

claims: EUR CoinVertible launched on XRPL with Ripple custody support.
SG-FORGE said it would explore use in Ripple products and as trading collateral.
limitations: Potential collateral use is not evidence of deployed collateral balances or borrowing.

claims: Aviva Investors and Ripple announced an initiative to explore tokenizing traditional fund structures on XRPL.
limitations: Announcement is exploratory; no token issuance or production volume established.

claims: Ondo, Kinexys by J.P. Morgan, Mastercard and Ripple completed a cross-border tokenized Treasury redemption pilot.
Ripple redeemed OUSG on XRPL in under five seconds; Mastercard MTN triggered fiat instructions and Kinexys/correspondent banking delivered USD to Ripple's Singapore bank account.
limitations: Asset leg used XRPL; USD leg used bank rails. This does not prove XRP was the settlement asset or collateral.

claims: Ripple made a strategic investment in Flutterwave's Series E.
Flutterwave announced RLUSD integration into payment rails and XRPL use for faster transaction clearing.
limitations: Announcement does not independently establish production volume or public XRPL support in the current stablecoin API matrix.

claims: Circle Ventures made a strategic investment in Flutterwave.
Flutterwave announced USDC settlement across its platform.
limitations: Investment and product announcement do not disclose chain-specific settlement volumes.

claims: Current documented networks are Solana (USDT/USDC), Ethereum (USDT/USDC/RLUSD), Base (USDC), Polygon (USDT/USDC).
XRPL is not listed in the current public stablecoin API network matrix.
limitations: Public documentation can lag private pilots or separate integrations; absence from the matrix is disconfirming evidence, not proof no private XRPL route exists.
